title: Global EMA9 Growth 30

rules.breakout_condition: Daily range > ATR(14) x 1.4, with daily and weekly EMA9 side alignment
rules.entry_trigger: BUY: low < EMA9 and close > EMA9 with bullish candle near high | SELL: high > EMA9 and close < EMA9 with bearish candle near low
rules.filter_mode: RSI(14) in 30.0-60.0, volume > SMA(14); market gate disabled

required_fields.notes: Tradable symbol name used by the strategy.
Dhan security identifier required for chart lookup.
Exchange routing segment such as NSE_EQ, NSE_FNO or MCX_COMM.
Instrument type used by the Dhan charts endpoint.
Close timestamp for the candle used by the strategy.
Intraday session VWAP when the strategy uses it.
Primary EMA9 trigger line if the strategy needs it.
Structured session range for UI and risk controls.
Highest call OI strike for option-barrier strategies.
Highest put OI strike for option-barrier strategies.
Put-call ratio when derivatives context is used.

notes: Daily+Weekly EMA9 strategy with ATR range expansion, volume, RSI and candle-body confirmation.
Quality mode can enforce ATR%, EMA9 slope, and stronger volume expansion.
Market benchmark gate is disabled for this strategy.
Telegram latest-trade alert is handled by backend strategy notifier using item notify_key signatures.
Curated live-supported index futures are appended to this market universe with the same strategy filters.
